open_points.subject: A03 startup sandbox verification
open_points.text: “the namespace's own loopback — up, as bubblewrap leaves it in a new network namespace” and “the kernel does not inspect or verify at run time — the start check (rule 8) asks only that a probe execution succeeds”
open_points.question: How must the kernel establish or verify that loopback is up, and must startup fail when the probe succeeds but loopback is absent or down?
options: Explicitly bring loopback up and verify it during the startup probe
Verify loopback during the startup probe but rely on bubblewrap to bring it up
Perform no verification and accept bubblewrap's resulting loopback state
open_points.default_guess: Explicitly bring loopback up, verify that it is the only interface in the startup probe, and refuse startup if that check fails.
